# Changelog — Build Platform

Format: [Keep a Changelog 1.1.0](https://keepachangelog.com/de/1.1.0/).

## [buildplatform-1.0.0] - 2026-11-11

### Added

- Release of the build platform through `tools/bin/nit-release buildplatform <X.Y.Z>`: the tag `buildplatform-<X.Y.Z>` runs `📦 Publish buildplatform to Maven Central`, which publishes the group `it.neckar.buildplatform` signed to Maven Central; `productDeclaration { }` and `delivery { }` live in `internal/closed/buildplatform-deployment` ([!20761](https://git.neckar.it/neckarit/neckar-hub/-/merge_requests/20761))
- Projects `it.neckar.buildplatform:projects` (registry types `ConfiguredProject`, `GradleProjectPath`, `GradleTaskPath`, `ProjectDependencies`, `ProjectRoot`, `ProjectType`, packages `it.neckar.projects`) and `it.neckar.buildplatform:generated-file-marker` (`GeneratedFileMarker`, `WriteGeneratedFile`, `FindGeneratedFileOrigin`, package `it.neckar.open.generated`), compiled with Gradle's embedded Kotlin; Maven Central publication of both follows later ([!20737](https://git.neckar.it/neckarit/neckar-hub/-/merge_requests/20737))
- Catalog alias `kotaml` (`io.heapy.kotaml:kotaml:0.113.0`), the maintained fork of the archived kaml with the same packages `com.charleskorn.kaml`; the alias `kaml` is absent ([!20691](https://git.neckar.it/neckarit/neckar-hub/-/merge_requests/20691))
- Artifact `it.neckar.buildplatform:version-catalog`: the version catalog of the monorepo, built from `internal/buildplatform/gradle/libs.versions.toml` and loadable via `from("it.neckar.buildplatform:version-catalog:<version>")`; version from `internal/buildplatform/buildplatform.version`, independent of `monorepo.version` ([!20588](https://git.neckar.it/neckarit/neckar-hub/-/merge_requests/20588))
